The season ran from 19 February to 5 November 2016.{{cite web|title=Angola 2016|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ango2016.html|website=RSSSF|access-date=10 February 2016}} The league comprised 16 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2016 Provincial championships. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|1º de Agosto]] won their first league title. ==Teams== A total of 16 teams contested the league, including 13 sides from the [[2015 Girabola|2015 season]] and three promoted from the [[2015 Segundona]] - [[FC Desportivo 4 de Abril|4 de Abril do KK]], [[Porcelana Futebol Clube do Cazengo|Porcelana]] and [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|1º de Maio]].
